Condition: User changes a wizard's name to match an existing wizard's name (case-insensitive).
Expected Behavior: Prevent name change and revert to previous value. Show error toast.
UI Action Details: A wizard named '[Name]' already exists. Please choose a unique name.

Condition: User attempts to activate a wizard for a category and shop combination that already has an active wizard.
Expected Behavior: Allow user to proceed by deactivating the existing active wizard.
UI Action Details: This category and shop combination already has an active wizard: '[Conflicting Wizard Name]'. Activating this wizard will automatically deactivate '[Conflicting Wizard Name]'. Do you want to proceed?

Condition: User attempts to activate a wizard without any category assigned.
UI Action Details: Please select an Item Category in the Assignments panel before activating this wizard.

Condition: User clicks 'Delete' on a wizard that is currently active.
Expected Behavior: Require user to type 'delete' to confirm destruction of active template.
UI Action Details: Warning: This wizard is currently ACTIVE. Deleting it will leave the assigned category layout disabled and impact live deal workflows.

Condition: User assigns workflow gates to steps out of order (e.g. earlier step triggers a status that comes chronologically after a later step's triggered status).
Expected Behavior: Validate gates order on Save. Block save and show error notification.
UI Action Details: Workflow gates must follow chronological status progression. Step '[Later Step]' (triggers [Later Status]) cannot occur after Step '[Earlier Step]' (triggers [Earlier Status]).

column10: Show confirmation dialog to prevent accidental loss of edits.
column12: You have unsaved changes. Are you sure you want to go back? Unsaved changes will be permanently lost.

Condition: User updates category/shop on an active wizard to a combination that already has a different active wizard.
Expected Behavior: Allow category change by deactivating the other active wizard.
UI Action Details: Category change conflicts with another active wizard '[Conflicting Wizard Name]' assigned to this category and shop. Proceeding will deactivate that wizard.

Condition: Wizard A is active for parent 'electronics'; Wizard B is active for child 'electronics.smartphone'.
Expected Behavior: Subcategories resolve to more specific wizard. No conflict.

Condition: Wizard A is active for 'watches' at 'Global'; Wizard B is active for 'watches' at 'Downtown Branch'.
Expected Behavior: Deals at Downtown Branch use Wizard B; other branches use Wizard A.

Condition: User saves a wizard containing a step with zero custom fields and 'NONE' associated action.
Expected Behavior: Step is displayed as 'Phase Not Required' in the deal workflow.

Condition: App initialization detects multiple active wizards for the same category and shop.
Expected Behavior: Deactivate all but the first active wizard found in storage to restore database consistency.
